name: Calvary
overview: Calvary, also known as Golgotha, is the specific location where Jesus was crucified, described in the Gospels as 'the place of a skull.' The four sample verses consistently identify this site by its Hebrew name Golgotha and its Greek equivalent, Calvary, emphasizing its significance as the place of Christ's sacrificial death. This location marks the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan through Jesus bearing His cross to this designated place of crucifixion.
